newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU hails U.S. chemical weapons ban ratification.
newsitem.headline: EU hails U.S. chemical weapons ban ratification.

text.p: The European Union welcomed on Friday the U.S. Senate's ratification of an international treaty banning the development, production and use of chemical weapons.
"The Presidency of the European Union is pleased that the U.S. Senate yesterday voted to give its consent to ratify the Chemical Weapons Convention," the Dutch EU presidency said.
"U.S. ratification is of particular importance, inter alia because the U.S. is one of the two states with declared possession of chemical weapons."
The United States became the 75th country to ratify the convention, which comes into force next Tuesday.

"It is important that as many countries in the world as possible accede to the treaty. Accession of states with significant chemical industries, as well as states in regions of tension, is of particular importance," the EU said.
Russia, the other declared possessor of chemical weapons stockpiles, has yet to ratify the treaty, and the EU urged it to do so as soon as possible.
